Tom Silva helps a homeowner remove a vinyl kitchen floor; Kevin O'Connor tours a well-stocked architectural salvage yard for vintage house parts; Richard helps a homeowner eliminate a gurgling sound coming from his bathroom plumbing.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S09 E26 — Yard Cleanup; Thermostats; Carpet Tiles
Yard clean-up using rakes, blowers and lawn vacuums; how HVAC thermostat technology has evolved over the years; general contractor Tom Silva and host Kevin O'Connor install carpet tiles over a concrete basement floor.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S10 E01 — Moving Trees; Hooking Up a Washer
Roger Cook and arborist Matt Foti kick off the 10th season by helping a homeowner transplant two trees; Richard helps a homeowner hook up the plumbing to her washing machine.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S10 E02 — Shower Valve; Banister
Helping a homeowner repair her shower valve that had been installed backwards; helping a homeowner rebuild her wobbly stair banister that was not built to code; the materials for this project are available at home centers and lumberyards.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S10 E03 — Water Heater; Range Hood
Replacing a corroded nipple fitting on a water heater; Tom helps a homeowner install a vented range hood in her kitchen; he cuts a hole in the exterior wall, installs a mounting block, hangs the exhaust fan above the stove and connects the ductwork.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S10 E04 — Hedge Pruning; Tile Backsplash
Landscaping contractor Roger Cook helps a homeowner prune an overgrown evergreen hedge; Roger, Kevin O'Connor, Richard Trethewey, and Tom Silva ask What Is It?; Tom helps a homeowner install a tile backsplash in his kitchen.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S10 E05 — Insulation; Foundation
Kevin O'Connor works with an insulation contractor to show the proper way to insulate a wall using fiberglass batts; Tom helps a homeowner repoint a fieldstone foundation.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S10 E06 — Shrubs; Baseboards
Roger Cook helps a homeowner remove several overgrown shrubs in front of her house and plant many new perennials; What Is It?; Richard helps a couple quiet their noisy baseboard heater by shortening the copper pipes and installing connectors.
